This is evident from the conversation where Phaedra brings up the interesting philosophical question of whether robots in Westworld could possess free will or if they are merely following their programming. LiHua explicitly engages with this theme, agreeing that some hosts likely experienced freedom but were always tied to their origins. This indicates a deep contemplation on the nature of consciousness and what it means to be human, as mirrored by the characters in the series. These philosophical underpinnings and the challenges to our understanding of artificial intelligence and autonomy are what elicit strong reactions and thoughts from LiHua, suggesting that they find this aspect of Westworld particularly compelling and thought-provoking.
